name: Sytry
source:
Sytry is the 12th pillar of Solomon, a viscount and Prince of Hell, who reigns over 60 armies of Hell. He is also a candidate nominated to succeed the throne by his uncle, Baalberith.
While disguised at William's school, he is referred as "Sytry Cartwright" and is treated like a princess at Stratford School because of his beauty.
